subject: design/implement-now-authenticated-review-obligations
statement: A Worker invokes a typed `GreenHandoff` after exact green and after its implementation process group is quiesced, but while its claim remains held. Before the handoff, the CodeHost adapter attaches the VerificationGate's immutable revision-bound verdict to the proposal revision and exact-reads it; this `implementation-green-capture/v1` native evidence is the crash-recovery source and is never inferred from a mutable head. The handoff receives identities already proven in that attempt—task, demand, implementation attempt, proposal, exact verified revision, semantic profile, effective review backend, and implementation terminal—then (when review is configured) persists/exact-reads the obligation and only afterward appends/exact-reads the existing EVT-10 routed-outcome composite. An unconfigured run appends EVT-10 alone.
